caseName: Sandres v. Louisana Div. of Admin.
caseNameFull: Naomi SANDRES v. LOUISANA DIVISION OF ADMINISTRATION, OFFICE OF RISK MANAGEMENT.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied, and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
